title: b7z9.30.2: C: implement post-step-6 SF floor enforcement
description: Spec R-02a-114: post-step-6 floors (EMA_SNR<-5 -> SF12; SNR<0 -> >=11; Density>8 -> >=11; Load>0.8 -> >=11). C has none. Rust applies floors only when SF is unassigned (rf_health.rs:390-393 vs :405-440); explicit AssignedSF bypasses them — also a bug. Python applies except after util>200 early-return — also a bug. Fix all three.
close_reason: Duplicate of project-LICHEN-worker6-b7z9.30.2 (closed by worker2, commit 8ea04cd3bd: post-step-6 floors a-d in C lichen_gradient_sf_select with boundary tests) and project-LICHEN-worker6-cvkj (closed: Rust explicit-SF path floors + step-3 parity). No remaining scope.
